records.localization_note: The short header Hodram Bergstrom stays distinct from the two controlled names used in introductions.
Janus Pasar gives the same name after Hodram clarifies that he is asking for Janus's name instead of the ship's.
Julio Erneco is Cristina's grandfather in this exchange. She calls him Grandpa because the relationship is explicit.
Cristina Erneco is the established current header. Mivor's address stays consistent with her introduction.
Yukihisa Shiraki is the short header. He introduces himself aloud as Yukihisa Genjo Shiraki.
Emilio Ferog is the full spoken introduction and the header, including the registered regular-font F.
Gerhard Adernkatz expresses his own doubts about the legend, the investment, and the proposed recruit.
Charles Rochefort is the crewmate who names chopsticks and reacts to Yukihisa's speed.
Sera Shahrbaraz is the short header when she returns to her homeland and interprets for Sirwood.
Julian Lopes is the current short header. Hodram addresses him by his given name at the crown exchange.
Sojin Kurushima is the header. He uses his surname in the threat to the visitors.
Sirwood Eme is the approved header for the man whose opaque words Sera interprets.
Mivor Genz introduces himself by the same name in London. His extravagant address to Cristina reflects his own feelings.
Shopkeeper remains the role label for the speaker heard in the bullring crowd.
Patron identifies a generic spectator. His laughter and approval convey no shared name or relationship.
Trader is the established role label for the spectator who announces the main performer.
Port Worker identifies both the source summons speaker and the same role appearing in the crowd.
Guildmaster is the existing role label for the spectator who shouts in approval.
Sailor is the header for Kurushima's follower. His spoken address to the leader is boss.
Boy is the role in the dockside aftermath and the matching literal caption in the earlier rescue panels. Familiar forms of address establish no kinship with the crew.
Lady is the existing role header. She explicitly says the boy is hers and thanks his rescuers.
